policy.name: Price Match / Ad Match
policy.fullTermsSource: Full policy text supplied by the user on 2026-11-01 (Ontario terms).
policy.rule: If a major supermarket competitor advertises a lower price on any identical item Real Canadian Superstore carries, the store sells that item at the competitor's price (up to 4 units per item) on showing the original print or official digital advertisement, during the advertisement's effective dates.
policy.eligibleCompetitorNote: The policy names no fixed competitor list: 'see in-store for a list of current competitors we ad match against', determined solely by each store. The engine set above is the practical flyer-data interpretation (major supermarket banners; excludes department, specialty and pharmacy sellers). The store's in-store list governs at the cashier.
policy.identityRequirement: Identical items: same brand, item type (unbranded produce, meat and bakery by type), size and attributes, carried at the store.
policy.evidenceRequirement: Complete original print or official digital advertisement (competitor online flyer/website): size, price, effective dates, format/weight.
exclusions: Competitor private-label offers on non-identical items
Discounts or coupons through loyalty programs including PC Optimum and PC Optimum Member Only Pricing
Third-party operations (post office, gas bars, dry cleaners, etc.)
Competitor misprints, errors, typos or corrected advertisements
policy.discretion: Real Canadian Superstore identifies the major supermarket competitor(s) per location and may refuse, cancel or change the program terms at any time.

recommendationRule: Real Canadian Superstore (Milton) is a home store. Only offers from major supermarket competitors may be labelled price-matchable at RCSS, and only for identical brand/type/size items, max 4 units, with complete current advertisement evidence. Offers from any other merchant are shown as not price-matchable at RCSS. Matched price equals the competitor price (RCSS matches, no beat).
